name: OTA_testcases
context:
I am validating OTA feature

tapping reload now button will always take to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that tapping 'Reload Now' triggers an immediate OTA update reload
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: Sheet displays message about new version with 'Reload Now' button and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Observe the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet

steps.expected_result: App reloads/restarts and applies the latest OTA update, returning user to the Home screen on the new version
steps.step: Tap the 'Reload Now' button

cases.title: Reload Now updates app immediately

cases.objective: Verify that tapping 'Maybe Later' dismisses the sheet and schedules update for next app launch
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: Bottom sheet dismisses and user remains on the Home screen without any reload
steps.step: Tap the 'Maybe Later' link

steps.expected_result: App automatically applies the OTA update on relaunch without showing the sheet again
steps.step: Close and reopen the app

cases.title: Maybe Later defers update to next app open

cases.objective: Verify the OTA update sheet overlays the Home screen without disrupting underlying UI
cases.precondition: User is logged in and navigates to the Home screen when an OTA update is available

steps.expected_result: Home screen content (greeting, streak, promo banner) is visible but dimmed/overlaid behind the bottom sheet
steps.step: Observe the Home screen when the update is available

steps.expected_result: Sheet shows 'Update Ready' title, description text, 'Reload Now' button, and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Verify the bottom sheet contains the correct text

cases.title: Update Ready sheet appears on top of home content

cases.objective: Verify that the OTA update sheet is not accidentally dismissible via a downward swipe gesture
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: Sheet remains visible and is not dismissed; user must choose 'Reload Now' or 'Maybe Later'
steps.step: Swipe down on the bottom sheet

cases.title: Sheet cannot be dismissed by swiping down

cases.objective: Verify that tapping the dimmed background behind the sheet does not dismiss it
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: Sheet remains open and no navigation occurs; update prompt stays visible
steps.step: Tap the dimmed Home screen area behind the bottom sheet

cases.title: Sheet cannot be dismissed by tapping background

cases.objective: Verify the OTA sheet does not re-display after a successful reload
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: App reloads and returns to Home screen
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now'

steps.expected_result: The 'Update Ready' sheet does not reappear since the update has already been applied
steps.step: Observe the Home screen after reload

cases.title: Update Ready sheet does not reappear after Reload Now

cases.objective: Verify the OTA update sheet is not shown when the app is already on the latest version
cases.precondition: User is logged in and app is already running the latest OTA version

steps.expected_result: Home screen loads normally without any 'Update Ready' bottom sheet appearing
steps.step: Open the app and navigate to the Home screen

cases.title: Update Ready sheet does not show when no update is available

cases.objective: Verify appropriate error handling when 'Reload Now' is tapped without network connectivity
cases.precondition: User is logged in, the 'Update Ready' sheet is displayed, and device has no internet connection

steps.expected_result: Device is offline
steps.step: Disable Wi-Fi and mobile data on the device

steps.expected_result: App displays an error message indicating the update could not be downloaded due to no connection, and the sheet remains or re-shows
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now'

cases.title: Reload Now with no internet connection

cases.objective: Verify the update sheet does not reappear during the same app session after choosing Maybe Later
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on the Home screen, and the 'Update Ready' bottom sheet is displayed

steps.expected_result: Sheet dismisses and user is on the Home screen
steps.step: Tap 'Maybe Later'

steps.expected_result: The 'Update Ready' sheet does not reappear during the same session
steps.step: Navigate away to another screen and return to Home screen

cases.title: Maybe Later then re-open without closing app shows no sheet
cases.execution_comment: Update is automatically updated/applied in the next visit

cases.objective: Verify that tapping Reload Now always lands the user on the Homepage, not any other screen
cases.precondition: User is logged in, on Home screen, and Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Sheet shows 'Reload Now' button and 'Maybe Later' link
steps.step: Observe the Update Ready bottom sheet displayed over the Home screen

steps.expected_result: App reloads and lands on the Homepage (Home screen), not a different tab or screen
steps.step: Tap the 'Reload Now' button

cases.title: Reload Now navigates to Homepage after update

cases.objective: Verify that even if the update sheet appears while user was previously browsing another section, Reload Now always returns to Homepage
cases.precondition: User is logged in, previously navigated to a non-home section, Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: User is on a non-home screen
steps.step: Navigate to a section other than Home (e.g., profile or habits)

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet overlays the current screen
steps.step: Wait for or trigger the Update Ready sheet to appear

steps.expected_result: App reloads and user lands on the Homepage, not the previously visited screen
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now'

cases.title: Reload Now from a non-home screen still navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that after choosing Maybe Later and re-opening the app, tapping Reload Now on the re-shown sheet navigates to Homepage
cases.precondition: User is logged in, Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: Sheet dismisses and user remains on Home screen
steps.step: Tap 'Maybe Later' on the Update Ready sheet

steps.expected_result: Update Ready sheet appears again on the Home screen
steps.step: Fully close and reopen the app

steps.expected_result: App reloads and user lands on the Homepage
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now'

cases.title: Maybe Later followed by Reload Now on next open navigates to Homepage

cases.objective: Verify that Homepage displayed after Reload Now shows expected content including greeting, streak, and promotional banner
cases.precondition: User is logged in, Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: App reloads
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now' on the Update Ready sheet

steps.expected_result: Homepage shows greeting (e.g., 'Good Afternoon'), current streak, best streak, week progress, and promotional banner intact
steps.step: Observe the Homepage that loads

cases.title: Homepage content is correct and intact after Reload Now

cases.objective: Verify the Reload Now button responds to tap and is not obscured or unresponsive due to the drag handle or sheet layout
cases.precondition: User is logged in and Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: No action or dismiss occurs; sheet remains open
steps.step: Attempt to tap the drag handle area at the top of the sheet

steps.expected_result: App reloads and navigates to Homepage successfully
steps.step: Tap directly on the 'Reload Now' button

cases.title: Reload Now button is tappable and not blocked by sheet drag handle

cases.objective: Verify that closing the 'Gut health, decoded' promotional banner behind the sheet does not dismiss or affect the Update Ready sheet
cases.precondition: User is logged in, promotional banner and Update Ready sheet are both visible

steps.expected_result: Tap is blocked by the sheet overlay; banner X is not triggered
steps.step: Attempt to tap the X button on the 'Gut health, decoded' banner visible behind the sheet

steps.expected_result: App reloads and navigates to Homepage
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now' on the sheet

cases.title: Promotional banner close (X) does not interfere with Update Ready sheet

cases.objective: Verify that user's streak and week progress data are not reset or lost after OTA reload
cases.precondition: User is logged in, has a current streak value (e.g., 30) visible, Update Ready sheet is showing

steps.expected_result: Values are noted
steps.step: Note the current streak value and best streak displayed on the Home screen

steps.expected_result: App reloads to Homepage
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now'

steps.expected_result: Current streak and best streak values match the previously noted values (30 and 38)
steps.step: Check the streak and best streak values on the reloaded Homepage

cases.title: User streak and progress data preserved after Reload Now

cases.objective: Verify that tapping Reload Now twice quickly does not trigger duplicate reloads, error, or app crash
cases.precondition: User is logged in, Update Ready sheet is visible

steps.expected_result: App performs a single reload and navigates to Homepage without crash or error
steps.step: Tap 'Reload Now' twice in rapid succession

cases.title: Rapid double-tap on Reload Now does not cause duplicate reload or crash
